about.body: The TDV8 and SDV8 are Ford/Land Rover joint-development V8 diesel engines, produced from 2006 to 2019. The 3.6L TDV8 was introduced first, followed by the 4.4L SDV8 (448DT) as a more powerful and more durable variant. These engines are fitted across three Land Rover model lines: the Discovery (L319 D3/D4), Range Rover (L322/L405), and Range Rover Sport (L320/L494). The 3.6L TDV8 is known for timing chain tensioner issues on early L322 models, while the 4.4L SDV8 is considered more durable with fewer reported catastrophic failures. We rebuild both variants to original specification with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

byModel.body: Across the Discovery (L319 D3/D4), the TDV8 and SDV8 were available from 2006 to 2016, offering V8 diesel power in the Discovery range. The Range Rover carried both engines across the L322 and L405 generations from 2006 to 2019, making it one of the most common applications for the V8 diesel. The Range Rover Sport also used the TDV8 and SDV8 across L320 and L494 chassis from 2006 to 2019, delivering high-performance diesel V8 power.

compatibility.body: Registration/VIN matching is required — 3.6L vs 4.4L variants differ significantly. The 4.4 SDV8 (448DT) is generally considered the more reliable option. Same engine family doesn't mean the same complete engine — specific ancillaries, mounting, and ECU/DME software differ by application.
compatibility.boldNote: We always confirm by registration/VIN before any rebuild or replacement.
